lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਨਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitavan chitavau pri preet bairaagee kad paavau har darasaaee ||
lines.translation: I think thoughts of Him; I miss the Love of my Beloved. When will I obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jatan karau ihu man nahee dheerai kooo hai re sa(n)t milaaee ||1||
lines.translation: I try, but this mind is not encouraged. Is there any Saint who can lead me to God? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਮਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam pu(n)n sabh homau tis arapau sabh sukh jaa(n)ee ||
lines.translation: Chanting, penance, self-control, good deeds and charity - I sacrifice all these in fire; I dedicate all peace and places to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek nimakh pri daras dikhaavai tis sa(n)tan kai bal jaa(n)ee ||2||
lines.translation: One who helps me to behold the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, for even an instant - I am a sacrifice to that Saint. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੇਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau nihoraa bahut benatee sevau din rainaaee ||
lines.translation: I offer all my prayers and entreaties to him; I serve him, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan hau sagal tiaagau jo pri baat sunaaee ||3||
lines.translation: I have renounced all pride and egotism; he tells me the stories of my Beloved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਈ ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh charitr bhaee hau bisaman gur satigur purakh milaaee ||
lines.translation: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the wondrous play of God. The Guru, the True Guru, has led me to meet the Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: prabh ra(n)g daiaal mohi grih mahi paaiaa jan naanak tapat bujhaaee ||4||1||15||
lines.translation: I have found God, my Merciful Loving Lord, within the home of my own heart. O Nanak, the fire within me has been quenched. ||4||1||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਬ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: re mooRhe too kiu simarat ab naahee ||
lines.translation: You fool, why are you not meditating on the Lord now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: narak ghor mahi uradh tap karataa nimakh nimakh gun gaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the awful hell of the fire of the womb, you did penance, upside-down; each and every instant, you sang His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੌ ਹੀ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik janam bhramatau hee aaio maanas janam dulabhaahee ||
lines.translation: You wandered through countless incarnations, until finally you attained this priceless human birth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਉ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਤਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਅਨ ਠਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: garabh jon chhod jau nikasio tau laago an thaa(n)hee ||1||
lines.translation: Leaving the womb, you were born, and when you came out, you became attached to other places. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਠਗਾਈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahi buraaee thagaaee din rain nihaphal karam kamaahee ||
lines.translation: You practiced evil and fraud day and night, and did useless deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਹ ਗਾਹਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kan naahee tuh gaahan laage dhaai dhaai dukh paa(n)hee ||2||
lines.translation: You thrash the straw, but it has no wheat; running around and hurrying, you obtain only pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਸਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa sa(n)g kooR lapataaio urajh pario kusamaa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: The false person is attached to falsehood; he is entangled with transitory things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਉ ਕਾਲ ਮੁਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai jab pakaras bavare tau kaal mukhaa uth jaahee ||3||
lines.translation: And when the Righteous Judge of Dharma seizes you, O madman, you shall arise and depart with your face blackened. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: so miliaa jo prabhoo milaaiaa jis masatak lekh likhaa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: He alone meets with God, whom God Himself meets, by such pre-ordained destiny written on his forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਲਿਪ ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tinh jan balihaaree jo alip rahe man maa(n)hee ||4||2||16||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being, who remains unattached within his mind. ||4||2||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu jeevan preetam bin maaee ||
lines.translation: How can I live without my Beloved, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਹੋਤ ਮਿਰਤਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke bichhurat hot miratakaa grih mahi rahan na paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Separated from Him, the mortal becomes a corpse, and is not allowed to remain within the house. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਹਂੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ha(n)ee praan ko daataa jaa kai sa(n)g suhaaee ||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of the soul, the heart, the breath of life. Being with Him, we are embellished with joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa sa(n)tahu mohi apunee prabh ma(n)gal gun gaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your Gace, O Saint, that I may sing the songs of joyful praise to my God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਥੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਾਈਁ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan sa(n)tan ke maathe mere oopar nainahu dhoor baa(n)chhaaee(n) ||
lines.translation: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. My eyes long for their dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: jih prasaad mileeai prabh naanak bal bal taa kai hau jaaee ||2||3||17||
lines.translation: By His Grace, we meet God; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਅਉਸਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa ausar kai hau bal jaaee ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that occasion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apanaa prabh simaran vadabhaagee har paa(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on my God; by great good fortune, I have found the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੈਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalo kabeer daas daasan ko ootam sain jan naaee ||
lines.translation: Kabeer is good, the slave of the Lord's slaves; the humble barber Sain is sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ooch te ooch naamadeu samadarasee ravidaas thaakur ban aaee ||1||
lines.translation: Highest of the high is Naam Dayv, who looked upon all alike; Ravi Daas was in tune with the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d tan dhan saadhan kaa ihu man sa(n)t renaaee ||
lines.translation: My soul, body and wealth belong to the Saints; my mind longs for the dust of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prataap bharam sabh naase naanak mile gusaaee ||2||4||18||
lines.translation: And by the radiant Grace of the Saints, all my doubts have been erased. O Nanak, I have met the Lord. ||2||4||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manorath poore satigur aap ||
lines.translation: The True Guru fulfills the mind's desires.
